review.notes: Gratis AI runs open-source language models entirely on the device; there is no account and no server of ours. On first launch the app checks the device and suggests a model; tap Get Started, then Start/Download. The model (about 0.7 GB for LFM 2.5 1.2B on iPhone) downloads once from Hugging Face, so please review on Wi-Fi; after that everything works offline, including in Airplane Mode. Models are third-party open-weight models used under their licences (Apache 2.0, LFM Open License, Gemma Terms); the licence of each model is shown in the picker. Answers are AI-generated and may be inaccurate.

MAC_OS.review_notes: Mac: the com.apple.security.network.server entitlement is required. Vision models (e.g. Qwen 3.5 2B, SmolVLM2) run in a bundled llama.cpp llama-server helper process that the app launches and talks to over HTTP. It listens on 127.0.0.1 only, on a random free port, protected by a random per-launch API key; it is never reachable from other machines and accepts no outside connections. The App Sandbox blocks listening sockets, loopback included, without this entitlement, so image input would fail. To exercise it: download a vision model in the picker, attach an image in a chat and ask about it.
